results.text: Good morning.
Can you tell me about your hometown?
Yes,
of course.
I grew up in a small city in the Nile Delta.
It is a fairly quiet place,
and most of the families there have known each other for generations.
I still live there with my parents.
And what do you do in your free time?
Well,
I spend quite a lot of my free time reading,
mostly history books.
I also meet friends at a coffee shop near my house on Fridays,
although recently I have been rather busy with work.
Do you think you will stay there in the future?
That is a difficult question.
Honestly,
I am not sure.
I would like to stay close to my family,
but the opportunities in my field are mostly in the capital,
so I may have to move eventually.
